newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia govt says budget affecting rates.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia govt says budget affecting rates.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello told Parliament on Monday the government's budget strategy was having a marked effect on interest rates.
"You would be aware that the government's budget strategy is having a marked effect on interest rates," Costello said.
He said the former Labor government always managed to raise interest rates, but failed to bring them down.

Hopes for a rate cut were boosted last week when data showed that annual wages growth had fallen to 3.5 percent in August from 3.7 percent in May and other figures showed inflation remained low in the September quarter.

Annual headline inflation fell to 2.1 percent in the September quarter, its lowest level for two years, while underlying inflation was 2.4 percent, compared to a 3.1 percent rise in the year to June 30.
The Reserve Bank of Australia last cut its official cash rate on July 31, by half a percentage point to 7.0 percent.
